 Alachua County Veterans Services hosting annual Veterans Day celebration 
 Attendees will be able to enjoy live music, aircraft displays, family activities and much more. By Kristin Chase Published : Nov. 9, 2026 at 7:31 AM EST | Updated : 30 minutes ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google GAINESVILLE, Fla. (WCJB) - Alachua County Veterans Services officials and the Alachua County Veterans Memorial Committee will host their annual Veterans Day celebration on Wednesday.
 This year’s theme is “The Strength Behind the Service.” It honors those who have served the country and also the families, caregivers and loved ones who stand beside them.
 Attendees will be able to enjoy live music, aircraft displays, family activities and much more.
 The event will be at Veterans Memorial Park in Gainesville. It will start at 7 a.m. with a free breakfast for veterans and then a Veterans Day Community 5K. The formal Veterans Day program will be at 11 a.m.
